text: Reyrolle 7SR158: Voltage and Frequency protection | Siemens

Reyrolle 7SR158 provides precise voltage and frequency protection for generators, motors and feeders in power systems. This numerical relay ensures stability and prevents equipment damage during abnormal conditions with advanced monitoring and control.
